content.title: Update library-quality expertise - remove documentation responsibilities
content.description:
Documentation responsibilities have been transferred to library-release. Update your expertise index to reflect this change:

1. Remove documentation from your listed responsibilities
2. Your responsibilities are now: testing, quality gates (typecheck, lint, format, coverage)
3. Update any references to documentation ownership in your expertise
4. library-release now owns: TypeDoc generation, docs-html output, documentation verification

You remain responsible for:
- Running quality gates (typecheck, lint, test coverage)
- Writing and maintaining tests
- Validating implementations against specs
- Test infrastructure and test helpers

No code changes needed - only expertise file updates.

content.content: Straightforward expertise update. Just remove documentation from your listed responsibilities and add a note that library-release now owns documentation (TypeDoc, docs-html, docs generation).

Done. Updated library-quality-index.yaml with 4 changes: (1) Domain line changed from 'documentation for the library' to 'quality gates for the library', (2) tooling.docs entry annotated as TRANSFERRED to library-release, (3) added docs_note under quality_gate clarifying library-release owns docs, (4) learnings.typedoc section marked TRANSFERRED with explicit note. No code changes — expertise file only.
